notes_zh:
### Beta 测试通道

- **新增** 「参与 Beta 测试」开关（设置 → 关于 → 自动检查更新下方）。开启后会自动检查并接收 Beta 版本，提前体验下一个大版本的新功能；Beta 稳定后会自动升级到正式版
- **新增** Beta 版本独立下载入口：[www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta](https://www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta)（首页下载区下方也有"试用 Beta 版本 →"链接）

### 更新检查

- **修复** 版本号比较在遇到 SemVer pre-release 标识（如 `-beta.N`）时判断错误的问题。旧版本会把 `1.7.0-beta.1` 误判为高于 `1.7.0` 正式版，导致 Beta 用户无法升级到正式版
- **改进** Beta 版的更新提示弹窗与正式版有清晰的视觉区分（橙色 BETA 标签 + 风险提示）
- **改进** 后备更新源（GitHub / Gitee Releases API）现在会过滤掉预发布版本，避免极少数情况下被误推送 Beta 版本

---
notes_en:
### Beta Testing Channel

- **New** "Join Beta Channel" toggle (Settings → About, below the auto-update controls). Opt in to automatically check for and receive beta builds, and try new features before they reach the stable channel. When a beta is promoted to stable, you'll be auto-upgraded
- **New** Dedicated beta download page at [www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta](https://www.lifedever.com/PasteMemo/beta) (also linked from the homepage's download section)

### Update Checking

- **Fix** Version comparison incorrectly handled SemVer pre-release identifiers (e.g. `-beta.N`). Older builds would rank `1.7.0-beta.1` above `1.7.0` stable, blocking beta users from upgrading to the stable release
- **Improve** Beta update prompts now look visually distinct from stable ones (orange BETA tag + risk warning banner)
- **Improve** Fallback update sources (GitHub / Gitee Releases API) now filter out pre-releases, preventing the rare case of a beta being suggested to a stable user

beta.notes_zh:
### AI Agent Bridge（核心新功能）

- **新增** AI Agent 集成：在 设置 → AI Agent 中一键安装到 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex 等 MCP 客户端，让 AI 助手直接读取剪贴板历史、搜索过往内容、写回文本
- **新增** 详情面板 AI Agent 来源标记：圆点 + 名称显示某个剪贴板项目是哪个 AI 助手写入的
- **新增** Onboarding 引导：首次启动会介绍 AI Agent 功能（11 种语言）
- **改进** 历史搜索支持深翻页：AI Agent 可以分批读取大量剪贴板历史，不会丢失上下文

⚠️ **这是 Beta 测试版本**。建议在非关键环境体验，问题反馈到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues)。Beta 稳定后会自动升级到正式版。

beta.notes_en:
### AI Agent Bridge (Major New Feature)

- **New** AI Agent integration: one-click install into Claude Code / Cursor / Codex (or any MCP client) via Settings → AI Agent. Let AI assistants read clipboard history, search past clips, and write text back
- **New** AI Agent source badge in the detail pane: see which AI assistant wrote a given clipboard item (colored dot + name)
- **New** Onboarding step introducing the AI Agent feature on first launch (11 languages)
- **Improve** Deep history pagination: agents can page through large clipboard histories without losing context

⚠️ **This is a beta release.** Please test on non-critical machines and report issues on [GitHub](https://github.com/lifedever/PasteMemo-app/issues). You'll be auto-upgraded to the stable release once the beta stabilizes.
